captions.instagram:
The everyday costs of an art business add up, and most of them count. For the business-use share:

✔️ iPad, software, brushes and paint. An IRS rule (the de minimis election) often lets you write off items up to $2,500 each the year you buy them.
✔️ Etsy listing, transaction and processing fees, plus shipping labels and postage.
✔️ Classes that improve skills you already use (not training for a new career).
✔️ Miles to art fairs, client installs and supply runs: 72.5 cents a mile for Jan. 1 to June 30, 2026 and 76 cents from July 1.

The habit that makes it work: photograph every receipt and note what it was for.

sources.fact: Business expenses must be ordinary (common and accepted in your field) and necessary (helpful and appropriate) (Pub 583, read 2026-10-24)
De minimis safe harbor: deduct amounts up to $2,500 per invoice or item (no applicable financial statement), with an annual election statement on the return (read 2026-10-25)
Self-employed include education expenses on Schedule C; must maintain or improve skills needed in present work; not minimum requirements or a new trade (Topic 513, read 2026-10-25)
2026 business standard mileage rate: 72.5 cents/mile Jan. 1-June 30; 76 cents/mile July 1-Dec. 31 (read 2026-10-25)
1099-K gross doesn't include adjustments for fees or shipping, which are business costs (Q8, read 2026-10-24)
